// diagnostic

E2411

`{Type}` can't be serialized / decoded, or a union member has no compiler-known wire shape.

What

`{Type}` can't be serialized / decoded, or a union member has no compiler-known wire shape.

Why

Only a structurally qualifying type gets a compiler-generated codec (by default or through `#Codable`/`#Encode`/`#Decode`), unless it supplies a hand-written codec. Anonymous-union decoding also needs each member's outer wire shape; a custom or imported decoder does not declare one (D-SERDE1, D-UNIONTYPE1).

Fix

add a compiler-derived codec, use a configured tagged enum or `#CodableAsBase` distinct type for a union member, or remove the unsupported type from the encoded value (for example, with `#Skip`).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2411: tests/ui/serde_field_not_serializable.stderr.

Error [E2411]: `Plain` can't be serialized
  --> tests/ui/serde_field_not_serializable.jet:12:5
    |
 12 |     inner: Plain
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: only types that opt in (and their fields) have a wire form; `Plain` does not
 Fix: add `#[Codable]` or `#[Encode]` to `Plain`, or remove it from the encoded value
